motion.interpretation: In-place/root motion, candidate-region path and proximity are distinct measurements. Candidate-region proximity does not establish hoof contact or planted stance. Root-relative path does not establish world hoof sliding without a forward-speed contract. Bone tails were not used as foot points.

review_qualifications.candidate_hoof_regions: The lowest 10% of leg-chain-weighted vertices is a candidate subset, not a validated sole or planted-contact region.
review_qualifications.independent_source_rejection: Separate Native Sol raw-source CPU review reproduced 7.846x edge stretch at raw edge 11559/11572 at t=0.10 s. This remains a valid rejection finding. The earlier scale/bind mismatch and exported-stray-Icosphere conclusions were withdrawn; those were importer/inspection interpretation errors.
review_qualifications.path: Root-relative path does not establish world hoof sliding absent a forward-speed contract.
review_qualifications.proximity: The 2.5% sampled mesh-height threshold is a proximity band, not a ground/contact test.
review_qualifications.report_recast: Labels and interpretation were corrected after review; numeric samples and geometry were not recomputed. Original run report is retained as report_observed_original.json.
review_qualifications.scale: Uniform display factor is based on pre-parent bounds before explicit scene update; source bind height was not verified. Frame-0 evaluated geometry is animated action state, not rest/bind geometry.

scope: Isolated unmodified Walk candidate diagnostic; no production promotion. Candidate hoof-region and proximity metrics only.

uniform_scale.interpretation: One common uniform parent scale was applied for inspection. Its factor came from pre-parent bounds before the explicit scene update; the source bind height was not independently verified. Reported evaluated dimensions are action-frame-0 dimensions, not a bind-pose measurement.
uniform_scale.transform: one common parent scales imported mesh, armature and helper objects uniformly; no vertices, joints, weights, animation keys or relative object transforms rewritten
